hypotheses.justification: Implied by hA. Mathlib has `IsSelfAdjoint.dense_domain` (Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/LinearPMap.lean): a self-adjoint LinearPMap has dense domain, because the adjoint is junk for non-dense domains. The proof only uses density in building the record field `A_dense` and in `reducingRestriction_isSelfAdjoint` (the library's own wrapper already passes `hA.dense_domain`). So replace `hAdense` with `hA.dense_domain`.

Implied by hA. Mathlib has `IsSelfAdjoint.isClosed` (same file), so `hA.isClosed` supplies the record field `A_closed`. The engine `generalizedSinTheta_unbounded_exact_real` and `unboundedSinThetaDataOfReducingSubspace` never use closedness (their closedness arguments are underscore-named).
Implied by hA0 via `IsSelfAdjoint.dense_domain`. It is only used to fill the record field `A₀_dense`, which `toData` ignores, so replace it with `hA0.dense_domain`.

Implied by hA0 via `IsSelfAdjoint.isClosed`. It is only used to fill the record field `A₀_closed`, which `toData` ignores (the argument is `_hA0closed`), so replace it with `hA0.isClosed`. Each of the four hypotheses can be deleted on its own, and all four can be deleted together.
